```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(here); library(knitr); library(kableExtra); library(dplyr); library(readr)
source(here("R","functions.R"))
deflator <- read_csv(here("data","processed","us_gdp_deflator.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE)
```

This page documents every variable in the final analytical datasets. Variables are grouped by dataset. Units, sources, transformations, and interpretive limitations are noted where relevant.

---

## IBRD loans (`data/processed/ibrd_loans_clean.csv`)

**Unit:** One row per loan instrument. Multiple rows may share a `project_id`.

```{r}
#| echo: false
tribble(
  ~Variable, ~Definition, ~Source, ~Unit, ~Notes,
  "loan_number",        "IBRD loan identifier (e.g., IBRD85930)",               "IBRD Statement",       "Text",    "Prefix IBRDB/IBRDG = guarantee; none present for Costa Rica",
  "project_id",         "World Bank project identifier (e.g., P148435)",         "IBRD Statement",       "Text",    "Join key to project-level tables",
  "project_name",       "Loan-level project name",                                "IBRD Statement",       "Text",    "May differ slightly from Projects List name",
  "country_economy",    "Country name",                                           "IBRD Statement",       "Text",    "All rows: Costa Rica",
  "loan_type",          "Financial instrument code (CPL/FSL/NPL/SCL/SCPD)",      "IBRD Statement",       "Code",    "Financial terms, not operational type; see 03_prepare_ibrd.R for classification",
  "loan_status",        "Current loan status",                                    "IBRD Statement",       "Category","As of 09/30/2026 snapshot",
  "board_approval_date","Board approval date (raw string MM/DD/YYYY)",            "IBRD Statement",       "Date",    "Source: IBRD Statement field",
  "board_date",         "Parsed approval date",                                   "Derived",             "Date",    "Parsed from board_approval_date using lubridate::mdy()",
  "approval_year",      "Calendar year of board approval",                        "Derived",             "Integer","",
  "original_principal_amount_us", "Original loan amount approved by IBRD Board", "IBRD Statement",       "US$",     "Nominal USD at time of approval; NOT money received",
  "cancelled_amount_us","Amount cancelled from original principal",               "IBRD Statement",       "US$",     "Includes full cancellation of Terminated loans",
  "undisbursed_amount_us","Remaining approved balance not yet drawn",             "IBRD Statement",       "US$",     "As of 09/30/2026",
  "disbursed_amount_us","Cumulative drawdowns since inception",                   "IBRD Statement",       "US$",     "CUMULATIVE BALANCE — not an annual flow; do not assign to approval year",
  "repaid_to_ibrd_us",  "Cumulative principal repaid to IBRD",                   "IBRD Statement",       "US$",     "As of 09/30/2026",
  "due_to_ibrd_us",     "Outstanding principal owed to IBRD",                     "IBRD Statement",       "US$",     "As of 09/30/2026",
  "loans_held_us",      "IBRD's net exposure",                                    "IBRD Statement",       "US$",     "Disbursed - repaid - sold to third parties",
  "net_principal",      "original_principal_amount_us - cancelled_amount_us",    "Derived",             "US$",     "Amount committed net of cancellations. Not 'money received'. For Terminated loans = 0.",
  "real_principal_2025","Inflation-adjusted original principal in 2025 USD",      "Derived",             "2025 US$","= nominal * (defl_2025 / defl_year). 2025 deflator preliminary.",
  "real_net_2025",      "Inflation-adjusted net principal in 2025 USD",           "Derived",             "2025 US$","As real_principal_2025 but applied to net_principal",
  "is_guarantee",       "Whether loan number is IBRDB or IBRDG prefix",           "Derived",             "Logical",  "No guarantees present in Costa Rica records",
  "instrument_group",   "Operational classification: Development Policy Loan or Investment Project Financing", "Derived", "Category", "Based on loan_type + project_name; see 03_prepare_ibrd.R",
  "period",             "Approval period grouping",                               "Derived",             "Category","1980–1989; 1990–1999; 2000–2009; 2010–2019; 2020–2025"
) |>
  kable(caption="IBRD loans clean — variable definitions") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), font_size=11) |>
  column_spec(1, bold=TRUE, width="12em") |>
  column_spec(2, width="18em")
```

## IBRD projects (`data/processed/ibrd_projects.csv`)

**Unit:** One row per project (aggregated from loan records). Join key: `project_id`.

```{r}
#| echo: false
tribble(
  ~Variable, ~Definition, ~Derivation,
  "project_id",         "World Bank project ID",                                     "From ibrd_loans_clean",
  "n_loans",            "Number of loan records for this project",                   "count() over project_id",
  "approval_year",      "Calendar year of first loan's board approval",               "first(approval_year)",
  "board_date",         "Parsed board approval date",                                 "first(board_date)",
  "period",             "Period grouping",                                            "first(period)",
  "instrument_group",   "Dominant instrument type",                                  "paste(unique())",
  "loan_type_codes",    "All loan type codes for this project",                       "paste(unique(loan_type))",
  "loan_status_summary","All loan statuses",                                          "paste(unique(loan_status))",
  "total_principal",    "Sum of original_principal_amount_us across all loans",       "sum()",
  "total_cancelled",    "Sum of cancelled_amount_us across all loans",                "sum()",
  "total_disbursed",    "Sum of disbursed_amount_us (cumulative, snapshot balance)",  "sum()",
  "total_repaid",       "Sum of repaid_to_ibrd_us",                                  "sum()",
  "net_principal",      "total_principal - total_cancelled",                          "Derived",
  "real_principal_2025","Sum of real_principal_2025 across loans",                   "sum()",
  "project_name",       "Project name (from Projects List if available, else loan)",  "Left join to projects_universe",
  "sector1_xl, sector2_xl, sector3_xl", "Sector classifications from Projects List", "Left join to projects_universe",
  "in_scope",           "Whether approval_year is in 1980–2025",                     "Derived"
) |>
  kable(caption="IBRD projects — variable definitions (project-level aggregates)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), font_size=11)
```

## IFC projects (`data/processed/ifc_projects.csv`)

**Unit:** One row per unique IFC project number (deduplicated from 40 disclosure rows to 30 projects).

```{r}
#| echo: false
tribble(
  ~Variable, ~Definition, ~Notes,
  "project_number",    "IFC project number",                                        "Primary key",
  "project_name",      "IFC project name",                                          "",
  "type_desc",         "Investment or Advisory Services",                            "",
  "status",            "Active / Completed / Pending",                              "",
  "sector",            "Full IFC sector classification code and name",              "Granular IFC taxonomy",
  "sector_group",      "Simplified sector grouping",                                "Derived: Financial Services / Energy / Tourism etc.",
  "approval_date_act", "Actual Approval Date",                                      "Available only for 2 Advisory Services projects",
  "projected_board_dt","Projected Board Date",                                      "PLANNED date, not confirmed approval",
  "best_date",         "Coalesce(approval_date_act, projected_board_dt)",           "Best available date proxy",
  "best_year",         "Year from best_date",                                       "Use with caution; projected dates only for investments",
  "date_type",         "Describes which date was used",                             "'Actual (Advisory only)' or 'Projected board date (indicative)'",
  "ifc_invest_usd_m",  "IFC own-account investment amount in USD millions",         "Parsed from 'Investment as Approved by The Board' text field",
  "n_docs",            "Number of disclosure documents for this project",            "",
  "is_advisory",       "type_desc == 'Advisory Services'",                          "",
  "is_investment",     "type_desc == 'Investment'",                                 "",
  "is_pipeline",       "status == 'Pending'",                                       "Insulet CR (51930) — excluded from historical analysis",
  "in_scope",          "best_year >= 1980 & best_year <= 2025",                    ""
) |>
  kable(caption="IFC projects — variable definitions") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), font_size=11)
```

> **IFC amounts are indicative and NOT comparable to IBRD sovereign loan principal.** They represent IFC's own-account investment in private entities. The `investment_text` field also includes syntax from the disclosure portal; amounts are extracted from the leading number.

## MIGA projects (`data/processed/miga_projects.csv`)

**Unit:** One row per deduplicated project (10 projects from 12 source rows; project 3639 uses FY2003 as canonical record).

```{r}
#| echo: false
tribble(
  ~Variable, ~Definition, ~Notes,
  "project_id",         "MIGA project identifier",                               "Integer",
  "title",              "Project title",                                          "",
  "sector",             "Sector (Tourism / Banking / Power / Transportation / Manufacturing)", "",
  "fiscal_year",        "MIGA fiscal year of guarantee issuance",                "FY = July–June; FY2008 = July 2007–June 2008",
  "gross_exposure_up_to","Maximum MIGA liability under issued contracts (US$ millions)", "NOT a loan; NOT capital received by Costa Rica",
  "description",        "MIGA guarantee description",                            "From MIGA project brief",
  "investor_country",   "Country of origin of investor",                         "",
  "in_scope",           "fiscal_year >= 1980 & fiscal_year <= 2025",            "Approximate calendar year mapping"
) |>
  kable(caption="MIGA projects — variable definitions") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), font_size=11)
```

> **Project 3639 (Grupo del Istmo de Papagayo)** appeared in FY2001, FY2002, and FY2003 with escalating cumulative exposures ($16.4M, $38.3M, $81M). The FY2001 and FY2002 rows were removed; the FY2003 row ($81M) represents the most complete disclosure. Summing all three rows would overcount by approximately $136M.

## US GDP deflator (`data/processed/us_gdp_deflator.csv`)

**Unit:** One row per year (1960–2025).

| Variable | Definition | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `year` | Calendar year | Integer |
| `defl` | US GDP deflator index | Indicator NY.GDP.DEFL.ZS from World Bank API. Base year 2020 = 100 (per API response). Annual. |

**Formula for converting nominal to real:**
```
real_2025 = nominal * (defl[year==2025] / defl[year==approval_year])
```

**2025 deflator value:** `r round(read_csv(here("data","processed","us_gdp_deflator.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE)$defl[read_csv(here("data","processed","us_gdp_deflator.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE)$year==2025],2)` (preliminary; may be revised).

## WDI context indicators (`data/derived/wdi_scope.csv`)

**Unit:** One row per year (1980–2025), Costa Rica. Retrieved from World Bank API.

| Variable | Indicator | Unit | Coverage in scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gdp_per_capita_usd` | NY.GDP.PCAP.CD | Current US$ per person | 46/46 years |
| `gdp_growth_pct` | NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG | Annual % | 46/46 years |
| `gini` | SI.POV.GINI | Gini index (0–100) | ~39/46 years (household survey years) |
| `life_expectancy_years` | SP.DYN.LE00.IN | Years | 45/46 years |
| `fdi_pct_gdp` | BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS | FDI inflows as % GDP | 46/46 years |
| `govt_debt_pct_gdp` | GC.DOD.TOTL.GD.ZS | Central govt debt % GDP | 6/46 years |

> These indicators are contextual only. They do not establish that World Bank lending caused any observed changes in these measures.
